identificationModule.officialTitle: Long-Term Follow-up Protocol for Subjects Treated With a CAR T-Cell Product on a Juno-Sponsored Clinical Trial

bioSpec.description: Genomic DNA prepared from peripheral blood mononuclear cells

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of patients with adverse events
Proportion of patients with detectable viral vector sequences
Proportion of patients with detectable RCR or RCL

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have received at least one dose of a Juno CAR T-cell product (listed above) in a Juno-sponsored clinical trial
* Patients who have provided informed consent for the long-term follow-up study

Exclusion Criteria:

* None. All patients who have previously received treatment with a Juno CAR T-cell product are eligible for this long-term follow-up study.
eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: Patients previously treated with a Juno CAR T-cell product on a Juno-sponsored clinical trial
